features: NO SCHEMA CHANGES, BUT TRANSFERS SAVE SOME NEW INFORMATION IN THEIR RECORD — They are the settlement choice for leases, the periods over which the pair of balance rows is divided, who was still a tenant on the day of the end, and the stops and the renewal information described below. No migration and no existing data rewritten: transfers recorded earlier do not have this information and are read as before, except for the ancillary charges statement for earlier ends of lease (third point below). Leases, like the succession of beta.48. When a tenant leaves and the instalment plan is no longer recalculated, the days after the exit are still to be decided: does whoever stands in for the tenant take them, or do they stay in the leaving tenant's instalments for the parties to settle between themselves? Beta.47 declared this choice not yet built. Now the program asks for it, carries it through to the ancillary charges statement and, when a later transfer shifts it, says so. Every calculation defect and every server sentence first had a red test; the fixes went through an adversarial review, several rounds on the fixes and an on-screen check. The defects found in the new features are fixed before release and do not appear among the fixes, which concern only what was already there.

CHANGED: AT THE END OF A LEASE THE SETTLEMENT IS CHOSEN — It applies to the end of a lease without a new tenant and to the change of tenant, when the transfer touches a plan that is no longer recalculated (instalments in the journal, a payment or a settlement already written) and the «What will change» panel proposes balance rows. The panel asks «Write the settlement» or «Don't write it», with neither pre-selected; without the choice the transfer is not recorded, and a request that arrives without it is refused. The choice is a single one for the apartment and the ticked appurtenances, it has to be made again if the people of the pair change, and the note is optional (if you write it, at least ten characters). It replaces the box «The parties settled between themselves», which disappears from leases and stays in sale and usufruct: a form left open from before the update that sends it counts as «Don't write it». Transfers already recorded with the box stay as they were. Where the choice exists, the sentences that said «who pays the days after the exit is decided by the administrator» point to it.

CHANGED: «WRITE THE SETTLEMENT» AND «DON'T WRITE IT» — With «Write», at the end of a lease without a new tenant the days after the exit pass to whoever pays in place of the tenant (the usufructuary, if there is one, then the owner, then the bare owner), each for their share; with a new tenant they pass to the new tenant. The balance rows enter the next plan of the same management. With «Don't write it» no balance rows are written, the days stay in the leaving tenant's instalments, and the parties settle them between themselves with the ancillary charges statement, without declaring an agreement. In both cases the plan the transfer takes stays as it is. An example: ancillary charges of € 360.00 for the year borne by the tenant, who leaves on 1 July. The tenant's 181 days are worth € 178.52, the 184 days after the exit € 181.48. With «Write», the € 181.48 go as a debit to whoever pays in place of the tenant and as a credit to the tenant; with «Don't write it» they stay in the tenant's instalments, and the statement says they have to be given back to the tenant.

CHANGED: THE ANCILLARY CHARGES STATEMENT FOLLOWS THE CHOICE — With «Write» the days after the exit appear as without tenant, paid by whoever took the pair. With «Don't write it» the tenant who left has the whole year in their instalments, their 181 days are worth € 178.52 and the € 181.48 of the days after the exit are «to be given back» to them, between the parties: in the summary, in the detail and in the printout, which also says «settlement not written». In the change of tenant with «Don't write it» the statement says how much the entering tenant reimburses the leaving one; after «Cancel the settlement» the statement goes back to 365 days, as before. The ends of lease recorded before this beta, with no choice in the record, are now read by the statement as «Don't write it»: if no other tenant remains on the unit, the tenant who left, who used to appear with 365 days, now has their 181 and is given back the days after the exit. If the unit has a manual balance written from the Wallet on the same management, the one earlier versions indicated for those days, the statement warns that they may already be settled. A plan generated by an earlier version, without the allocation recorded, is left out of the statement after a change of tenant, and the panel says so.

CHANGED: TRANSFERS ARE CANCELLED IN THE ORDER THEY WERE RECORDED — The last one recorded first, not the last by date. A transfer recorded later, even with an earlier date, may read what the other one wrote (the pair of an end of lease divided on the ownership after a sale, the sources of a succession, a stop): cancelling the other first would leave wrong money. A sale of 1 October recorded before an end of lease of 1 July with «Write», cancelled first, would leave the buyer with a balance row of € 90.74 without being an owner any more. The refusal says which transfer, recorded later, has to be cancelled first. Two co-owners who sell, recorded against the order of the dates, used to require starting from the one with the latest date.

CHANGED: THE APPURTENANCES CARD APPEARS IN LEASES TOO — In the end and in the start of a lease, as in a sale, you tick the appurtenances the contract includes (the garage, for example): the date and the settlement choice apply together to the apartment and the ticked appurtenances. The transfer on the garage receives the contract's regime and end date, and the garage's statement reads the choice from the apartment's transfer. Whoever enters as tenant cannot already be the owner of a ticked appurtenance. At the start of a lease the entering tenant becomes tenant of the garage at 100 %, whatever their share of the apartment, and the panel says so.

CHANGED: THE «WHAT WILL CHANGE» PANEL SCROLLS ON A LARGE SCREEN — On a wide screen the panel never exceeds the height of the screen and scrolls inside itself, with the title always in view: the two options of the choice, at the bottom, are reached without scrolling the whole page. On a phone it stays in the column.

CHANGED: THE PAIR, BY PERSON, BY DAY AND BY CHAPTER — Without a new tenant the pair is divided over the whole period after the exit by person (with all their rows), by day (whoever buys halfway through takes the days from their sale) and by chapter, each item with its own period; an income item, such as antenna rent, subtracts with its sign. The division is by largest remainders: the cent goes to whoever has the largest remainder, and on a tie to whoever leaves; between the pair and a plan generated after the end at most one cent per unit can remain. The days after the exit that nobody covers stay in the leaving tenant's instalments, and the panel says so: if the row of whoever pays in place of the tenant ends on 30 September and afterwards there is no owner, they get their 92 days (€ 90.74) and the other € 90.74 stay in the tenant's instalments.

CHANGED: THE TENANT WHO STAYS — At the end of a lease where another tenant stays on the unit, the program does not propose the settlement of the days after the exit and there is no choice: it does not guess who they go to. The panel says the figure, that it stays in the leaving tenant's instalments, and that the parties decide who pays it. The manual balance from the Wallet is indicated only if it can really be done, that is if neither of the two people already has a balance on that management, unit and year (the Wallet accepts a single row per person, management, unit and year); otherwise it says that the part is settled between the parties. The transfer asks for the tick «I have read what will change» in the box «This transfer touches accounts already under way», and the history keeps the stop. The panel and the form no longer say «the unit stays vacant» where a tenant stays: they say «Dora stays as tenant», and the form looks at who is a tenant on the date written, also for an end recorded late.

CHANGED: THE STOP AFTER «WRITE» — After an end of lease with «Write», whoever pays in place of the tenant took the days after the exit with the pair. If a later transfer lowers their weight among those who stand in for the tenant (a sale, even dated before the end and recorded after; the creation or the termination of a usufruct, also with accretion; a succession with the arrears in the deceased's name and «Write»), the part of those days from the transfer onwards does not pass by itself to the entering person: without the stop it would stay with the seller, silently (in the example, a sale from Ugo to Elsa on 1 October: € 90.74 more for the seller and less for the buyer). Now the program records the transfer, does not move that part and says so with the person, the figure and the manual route, and asks for the tick «I have read what will change» and the note; the unit's history and the transfer's record keep the stop. The figure counts only the days without a registered tenant. The manual route is a manual balance from the Wallet only if neither of the two people of the row already has a balance on that management, unit and year, otherwise the part is settled between the parties: towards the condominium nothing moves silently, and whoever took the pair stays the debtor. The following are not stops: the reserve, the succession with the arrears to the heirs, «Don't write it» and an end of lease whose settlement was cancelled. A second sale after a stop says its own part, to be settled between the parties because the program does not know how the first was settled (end of Ines on 1 July, sale from Ugo to Elsa on 1 September with a stop of € 120.33 towards Elsa, then from Elsa to Carlo on 1 November: € 60.16 of those days are Carlo's), and the history of the first says how much passed. If the entering person's part is a credit, because an income exceeds the expense of their days, the stop says the credit figure (in the tested case € 29.26 in credit to Elsa): a credit is said in words, never with «€ -».

CHANGED: THE START OF A LEASE AFTER AN END WITH «WRITE» — A renewal with the same person, a return, or a new tenant in two steps are not stops but information: the entering tenant reimburses with the statement the days the pair gave to whoever was paying in their place, and the panel says so with names. In a renewal it also says that the end, if it is the last transfer, can be cancelled and recorded again with «Don't write it». After a stop, the start removes from the stop the days of the new tenant and says how much is left to settle.

CHANGED: SEVERAL TRANSFERS IN A ROW — After a change of tenant with «Don't write it» the days of the person who entered are in the instalments of the one who had left: if they leave too, the end does not write a pair in their credit for days they did not pay. After a change settled between the parties (the box from before, or the cancelled settlement) followed by the «Write» end of the person who entered, the statement follows the chain, with the line «settled between the parties at the change of tenant of …». The tenant who stays is recognised by a single rule, the statement's, and from the record: the recorded end remembers who stayed as tenant that day, unit by unit.

CHANGED: «CANCEL THE SETTLEMENT» WARNS IF A SALE STOPPED ON THAT PAIR — Before confirming, the history says the stop of the sale and the manual Wallet balance to review; once the settlement is cancelled, it says that stop no longer applies. It warns and does not refuse: a refusal would leave the settlement blocked when the sale can no longer be cancelled. The message that follows, when it carries a warning, does not close by itself.

CHANGED: AFTER RECORDING, THE BOX NAMES WHO PAYS IN PLACE OF THE TENANT — At the end of a lease without a new tenant the green box says the figure and the person («… as a debit to …, who pays in place of the tenant in the days after the exit») and leads to their account statement; before, it spoke of an entering person who does not exist.

FIXES — The panel no longer gets stuck after «No one». At the end of a lease, once the date was written and the short calculation delay had passed, ticking «No one — the unit stays vacant» did not change the preview: the panel stayed on «The panel is reading the form.» and «Record transfer» stayed off. It happened in beta.49 too. Now the calculation restarts when the form becomes complete. In every transfer, an old answer of the preview, arriving after a change in the form, no longer switches the «Record transfer» button back on: until the panel has read the form as it is now, the button stays off. The page of the usufruct transfers no longer receives the tax code of people who are no longer holders: it did not show it, but it received it. The note that the credit realignment writes in the journal no longer carries the version («as the issuing writes it today»): the entry stays in the journal forever, and a beta number in there goes stale. Notes already written stay as they were, and the description «Riallineamento crediti (1.11)» does not change. The realignment confirmation says that the entries take the accrual date and the year of the entry they correct, and that the posting date is today, the date the journal shows: whoever looked for the correction at the date of the offset did not find it. The «Charges» card of the account statement says «the instalments issued to the owner and the refunds of their credit», and that a reversed payment and its reversal stay in the list, not in the total: it said «and any restored debts», which since beta.49 do not enter «Total charges».

ERRATUM TO BETA.49 — The beta.49 changelog said that offsetting and refunds took the carried-over credit from «Receivables from owners», where nobody had written it. For offsetting that was true; for refunds it was not, if the share was entirely in credit: it already came out of the «Past Management Fund», since beta.31. Beta.49 changed refunds only for a share with an amount greater than or equal to zero and a carried-over credit, which came out of «Receivables from owners». Its «Not yet» called the list of the General Journal the «cash book»: the cash book is another page. And among the changes of behaviour it said that the realignment writes «in the date and the year» of the entry it corrects: the date is the accrual date, and the posting date is today.

THE GUIDES — The transfer guide says that at the end of a lease the settlement is chosen and what the two options do, where the choice does not exist, that after «Write» a sale does not move the part the pair has already given, and that the last transfer recorded is cancelled first. The balances guide and the instalment plan guide say that at the end of a lease without a new tenant the pair goes to whoever pays in place of the tenant, and that an end of lease with the settlement not written also keeps the plan fixed.

NOT YET — Income items (antenna rent, for example) still have edge cases in the days after the tenant's exit, when their period is after the exit and they exceed the expense: after a change of tenant in one step with «Write», followed by the end of the person who entered, the statement leaves the income in the instalments of the tenant who left first; and the printout, when the person who left has to receive a refund, says the reversed direction and a figure with a minus sign. They are rare cases and will be fixed in the next beta. With income items, until the next beta fixes them, avoid three operations that today give wrong figures without saying so, and that were already there in 1.10: «Sposta spesa» (move expense) between an expense and an income item (the plan total changes by twice the amount moved), an invoice or an immediate settlement recorded on an income item, and a negative amount written on an expense item instead of choosing the «Entrata» (income) type. The actual collection of a third-party income, such as the antenna rent paid to the condominium, is not recorded yet: the plan asks the owners for the expenses net of the income, but that money has no entry, and at year end bank and balance sheet stay below by the amount; it comes with the annual accounts. With a tenant who stays, the program does not divide the days after the exit among the remaining tenants with the plan's rule. A Wallet row tied to the transfer, removed by the cancellation, does not exist: the manual balance written for a stop stays, and the warning says so. Other known limits: the preview of a lease start on a unit with a tenant already at 100 % says it can be done, and the recording refuses it; with the garage ticked in a lease three sentences of the panel are imprecise; at 375 px the path at the top of the page overflows by 16 px with a very long condominium name.

FOR DEVELOPERS — No migration: the choice lives in the transfer's record (conguaglio.scelta, scritto or non_scritto, with the periods of the pair in conguaglio.periodi) and in the conguaglio field of the request (scrivi or non_scrivere), now allowed at the end of a lease too. New classes: ChiPagaAlPostoDellInquilino (who pays in place of the tenant by person and by day; a copy of the CalcoloQuoteService rule, not shared code) and FermataDopoScrivi. New record fields: fermata_dopo_scrivi, fermata_ridotta, fermata_coinquilino, coinquilini_letti, rinnovo_dopo_scrivi. Subentro::haUnConguaglio() reads the record. AnnullaPassaggioAction cancels in order of recording. On the page side rinunciaConguaglio.ts. New tests: FineLocazioneSceltaTest, CambioInquilinoSceltaTest, CoinquilinoCheRestaTest, ProspettoFineLocazioneTest, ProspettoFineLocazioneStampaTest, FermataDopoScriviTest, InizioDopoScriviTest, CorrezioniDellaBeta50Test, RevisioneBeta50MotoreTest, StrettoBeta50MotoreTest, UltimoGiroBeta50Test, ChiusuraBeta50Test, MutazioniCorrezioniBeta50Test and the vitests sceltaConguaglioLocazione, AnteprimaPassaggioLocazione, PassaggioNewLocazione; rewritten on the choice FineLocazioneFrasiTest, InizioLocazionePianoFermoTest, ProspettoCambioInquilinoTest, StatoDelPianoDopoPassaggioTest, SuccessioneRichiestaTest.
